notes.title: Guroopia! Pre-Release Featurette Video: Meeting The Deadline
notes.content:
Nearing the end of a game development cycle, the last week can be a real rush! I gave myself a deadline to completely finish Guroopia! and I had a ton of things to get done in that time.

Will I meet the deadline??
